unit: central-baseline (stress: rare family never logged at home)
what: Baseline only, outside the federated path. The same network trained on the pooled train days of both sites with each site's rare-family labels withheld at home, so it sees every family exactly where the federated model does.

target.metric: AUROC on the frozen test days for the withheld family at home (Site A: y_mobility, Site B: y_congestion), central model
target.direction: expected at or above 0.95; the reference the federated model is measured against

threshold_rule: a withheld family has no labels at home, so its F1 threshold is calibrated on the other site's validation days
